gen-righteous-gf-aldrich: Aldrich has a tall x-height that nearly meets its capitals, and its round letters look cupped rather than clenched. Righteous, up top, fills its line with fat bowls.
gen-righteous-gf-alexandria: Bent-rod letters with bowls that fill the line give Righteous a loud, playful voice at the top. Alexandria answers by being the quiet one, a plain sans with wide c terminals and a tall body.
gen-righteous-gf-amiko: Amiko reads modern and unfussy, with lowercase as tall as a thick crayon mark and terminals that point outward. Amiko keeps that steady texture going under Righteous, whose stems and arcs move in lockstep.
gen-righteous-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla feels approachable and contemporary, with wide s curves barely curled in and a short climb to its ascenders. Anek Bangla is the relaxed half, while Righteous brings arches on r, n and m that match their stems.
gen-righteous-gf-anek-devanagari: Modern and neutral in mood, this pairing puts Righteous on top, its neon-tube letters all one constant thickness. Anek Devanagari sits beneath with open letter mouths and a tall middle zone, so the sans-serif body feels spacious next to the sign-like heading.
gen-righteous-gf-anek-gujarati: Approachable and clean, Anek Gujarati has lowercase that rivals its capitals and a gaping c opening. Righteous is best at shouting from a single neon-tube track width, and Anek Gujarati at being a plain sans that welcomes the eye.
gen-righteous-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Fun and loud, Righteous bends its bowls to fill the line with no thick-thin pulse. Anek Gurmukhi then lays big open counters and open-handed curves beneath, a sans-serif body that lets the heading stay the star.
gen-righteous-gf-anek-malayalam: Bent steel rod, zero stroke modulation, and bowls that fill the line: Righteous looks like a sign. Anek Malayalam sits below as a sans-serif with little gap between x-height and caps.
gen-righteous-gf-anek-odia: Righteous bends every letter from one thin rod, with no vertical emphasis and no horizontal thinning. And Anek Odia follows with unsealed rounds and capitals barely above lowercase, a sans-serif that stays out of the heading's way.
gen-righteous-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil reads modern and contemporary, with big round lowercase bowls and c and s shapes that look half unwrapped. Anek Tamil would hold up if Righteous were made small, though that bent-rod heading carries more punch at larger sizes.
